title: RAG Pipeline Overview
description: Trace a static RAG flow from query to documents, chunks, embeddings, retrieval, context, LLM response, and citations.

starter_files.content:
# RAG Pipeline Overview

This planning lesson uses static metadata only. It does not call embedding models, query a vector database, or generate an LLM response.

learning_objectives: Identify the major stages in a RAG pipeline.
Explain why documents are chunked before retrieval.
Describe how citations connect an answer back to source material.
Recognize hallucination risk points in retrieval and response generation.

pipeline_nodes.label: User Query
pipeline_nodes.beginner_explanation: The learner starts by asking a question.
pipeline_nodes.engineer_explanation: Prompt input enters the pipeline as the query that retrieval will try to support.

payload.query: What does PROJECT OOH-AHH teach about runtime trace events?

pipeline_nodes.label: Document
pipeline_nodes.description: A trusted source document is available for retrieval.
pipeline_nodes.beginner_explanation: The system needs trusted source material before it can ground an answer.
pipeline_nodes.engineer_explanation: Document metadata identifies the source boundary used for chunking and retrieval.

pipeline_nodes.label: Chunker
pipeline_nodes.description: The document is split into a retrievable chunk.
pipeline_nodes.beginner_explanation: The document is split into a smaller piece that is easier to search.
pipeline_nodes.engineer_explanation: Chunk metadata records the retrievable unit, source document id, and token estimate.

pipeline_nodes.label: Embedding Model
pipeline_nodes.description: Mock embedding metadata represents text for similarity search.
pipeline_nodes.beginner_explanation: The chunk is turned into a search-friendly meaning pattern.
pipeline_nodes.engineer_explanation: Mock embedding metadata stands in for vector generation; no embedding API is called.

pipeline_nodes.label: Vector Store
pipeline_nodes.description: The mock vector store indexes chunk metadata for retrieval.
pipeline_nodes.beginner_explanation: The searchable chunk is placed where retrieval can find it later.
pipeline_nodes.engineer_explanation: Mock vector store metadata describes the collection/index without adding a database dependency.

pipeline_nodes.label: Retriever
pipeline_nodes.description: Retrieval selects the most relevant chunk for the query.
pipeline_nodes.beginner_explanation: The system picks the source chunk that best matches the question.
pipeline_nodes.engineer_explanation: Retrieval uses static top-k match metadata, including selected chunk ids and score placeholders.

pipeline_nodes.label: Context Builder
pipeline_nodes.description: The query and retrieved source are assembled for the LLM.
pipeline_nodes.beginner_explanation: The question and selected source are bundled together for the answer step.
pipeline_nodes.engineer_explanation: Context assembly records which retrieved chunk ids would be included in the model prompt.

pipeline_nodes.label: LLM
pipeline_nodes.description: A future model would generate a response from the assembled context.
pipeline_nodes.beginner_explanation: A future AI model would write an answer using the supplied source.
pipeline_nodes.engineer_explanation: The LLM node is a static placeholder; no model request or generation occurs.

pipeline_nodes.label: Response
pipeline_nodes.description: The planned response should stay grounded in the retrieved source.
pipeline_nodes.beginner_explanation: The answer should say only what the selected source supports.
pipeline_nodes.engineer_explanation: Expected response metadata includes the planned answer and citation ids for grounding checks.

pipeline_nodes.label: Citation
pipeline_nodes.description: The citation links the response claim to the retrieved chunk.
pipeline_nodes.beginner_explanation: The citation shows which source supports the answer.
pipeline_nodes.engineer_explanation: Citation metadata maps a response claim to a retrieved chunk and document id.

pipeline_nodes.label: Risk
pipeline_nodes.description: Unsupported claims are a hallucination risk point.
pipeline_nodes.beginner_explanation: This warning marks where an answer could make a claim without enough source support.
pipeline_nodes.engineer_explanation: Risk metadata flags unsupported answer generation or weak retrieval grounding in static lesson data.

hints: Follow the pipeline from the user query to the cited response.
Chunks are the pieces the retriever can search over.
A response is stronger when each important claim points back to a source.
